verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Facial Similarity reports compare a live selfie/video/motion capture to the document photo, with a liveness component requiring random head-turn movements (docs-12, docs-18, docs-30), which implicitly guards against static photo replay. However, there is no explicit documentation naming specific defenses against printed photos, screen replays, or video injection attacks, nor any anti-spoofing certification (e.g., iBeta/PAD level) details. Missing for 10: explicit anti-spoofing/PAD documentation against printed photo, screen, and replayed-video attacks, and any third-party liveness certification evidence.
